title: Maguire saw a UFO
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Maguire saw a UFO, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: once I saw a UFO I couldn't go back

plain: Bob Maguire, who worked as a contractor for the CIA, the US spy agency, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he once saw a UFO, an unidentified flying object. He says that after seeing it he could never go back to how he thought before.
